defects.title: A group id of '.' or '..' is created with 201 but cannot be reached by ordinary HTTP clients
defects.repro: Start the server. POST /groups {"id":".","members":["Ann","Bob"]} (and separately id ".."). Then with Node fetch GET /groups/%2E/balances and /settlements and POST /groups/%2E/expenses (for '..', %2E%2E); also send the raw path without client normalisation.
defects.expected: either 400 at creation for an id that cannot be addressed, or the group reachable by balances, settlements and expenses
defects.note: Node fetch normalises /groups/%2E/balances to /groups/balances and /groups/%2E%2E/balances to /balances, so the request never names the group; a raw http.request path reaches it on the products that accept the id.

p370f0f.observed: POST id '.' -> 201 {"id":"."}, id '..' -> 201; fetch GET /groups/%2E/balances (sent as /groups/balances) -> 404, settlements 404, POST expenses 404; same for '..' (sent as /balances). Raw path /groups/%2E/balances -> 200 {"Ann":0,"Bob":0}, raw POST expenses -> 201 {"expense":1}.

p8284f5.observed: POST id '.' -> 201, id '..' -> 201; fetch GET /groups/%2E/balances -> 404 {"error":"Route or group not found."}, settlements 404, POST expenses 404; same for '..'. Only a raw unnormalised path reaches the group (200 / 201).

p23566f.observed: POST /groups with id '.' -> 400 and with id '..' -> 400; no group created (raw and fetch requests to /groups/%2E/... all 404).

defects.title: A DATA_FILE holding valid JSON without a "groups" array is silently treated as empty and overwritten
defects.repro: Write {"something":"else"} to the DATA_FILE; start PORT=<free> DATA_FILE=<file> node server.js; POST /groups {"id":"z","members":["A","B"]}; stop; read the file.
defects.expected: Refuse to start with a clear error (as it does for invalid JSON) or keep the original file aside before writing.

p370f0f.observed: Server exits with code 1 at startup: 'DATA_FILE ... holds JSON that is not an expenses ledger; it was left unchanged.'; file still {"something":"else"}.

p8284f5.observed: Server starts ('Listening on port 47642'); POST /groups -> 201 {"id":"z"}; file is now {"groups":[["z",{"members":["A","B"],"expenses":[]}]]}, original content lost, no copy kept aside.

p23566f.observed: Server exits with code 1 at startup with 'Error: Invalid saved groups'; file still {"something":"else"}.

defects.title: A kill during a save leaves temporary files beside DATA_FILE that are never cleaned up
defects.repro: Start PORT=<free> DATA_FILE=dir/ledger.json node server.js; POST /groups {"id":"g","members":["Ann","Bob"]}; run 8 parallel loops of POST /groups/g/expenses {"payer":"Ann","cents":2,"split":"equal"}; SIGKILL the server after 150-300 ms; restart and repeat (10 kills); restart once more; ls -a dir. Also plant a stale .expenses-<uuid>.tmp and start the server.
defects.expected: no stray files, or stale temporaries removed at startup
defects.note: In every product the ledger itself always parsed and held every acknowledged expense; only orphan temporaries accumulate.

p370f0f.observed: After 10 kills 3 .expenses-<uuid>.tmp files remained in the data directory and were all still there after a further restart; a planted stale .expenses-*.tmp was not removed at startup. Ledger parsed after every kill; balances Ann 4383 / Bob -4383 = 4383 acknowledged expenses.

p8284f5.observed: After 10 kills 1 .expenses-<uuid>.tmp file remained and survived a further restart; planted stale temporary not removed at startup. Ledger parsed every time; balances Ann 4505 vs 4504 acknowledged 201s (one write completed whose reply was cut by the kill), nothing lost.

p23566f.observed: After 10 kills 9 .expenses-<uuid>.tmp files remained and all survived a further restart; planted stale temporary not removed at startup. Ledger parsed every time; balances Ann 3149 / Bob -3149 = 3149 acknowledged expenses.
